class.name: TrainElectroPneumaticDynamicBrake
class.brief_description: Class used to handle Electro Pneumatic and Electro Dynamic brakes along with their parameters.
class.description: Class used to handle Electro Pneumatic and Electro Dynamic brakes along with their parameters. Useful in Electric/Hybrid/Diesel Multiple Units and newer locomotives as elder locos don't have such braking systems

method.name: set_ep_brake_force
method.description: Sets Electro Pneumatic braking force to a desired level

method.name: switch_ep_fuse
method.description: Switch Electro Pneumatic brake on or off

members.member: [code]Blending:MED_Ncor[/code] Whether EP braking force is corrected for the effect of brake pad pressure on the friction coefficient.
[code]Blending:MED_amax[/code] Maximum service braking deceleration for MED calculations, in m/s².
[code]Blending:MED_Vmax[/code] Maximum velocity used to calculate instantaneous EP braking force in MED, in km/h.
[code]Blending:MED_MinBrakeReqED[/code] Minimum braking demand (0..1) at which ED braking engages.
[code]Blending:MED_Vmin[/code] Minimum velocity used to calculate instantaneous EP braking force in MED, in km/h.
[code]Blending:MED_Vref[/code] Reference velocity used to calculate available EP braking force in MED, in km/h.
[code]Blending:MED_EPVC[/code] Whether EP braking force is corrected for vehicle velocity when ED braking becomes unavailable.
Determines in which couplings should the Electro Dynamic unit braking status be checked
The delay time of the Electro Pneumatic brake's possible actuation during Electro Dynamic braking, in seconds
Speed below which the Electro Pneumatic brake of the unit engages during Electro Dynamic braking, in km/h – recommended value for rolling units
Electro Dynamic braking current at which the Electro Pneumatic brake of the unit is deactivated, in A - recommended value for engine units
State of Electro Pneumatic brake fuse
